description: This file contains implementation code for prepacking quantized convolution weights for different backends (FBGEMM, QNNPACK, OneDNN) in the PyTorch codebase. It includes functions for preparing weights for efficient execution across various hardware and acceleration libraries, along with registration of related functions in PyTorch's dispatch system.

classes.name: QConvPackWeightInt8
classes.description: A class template for packing weights for quantized convolution operations supporting multiple dimensions, with static methods for running convolution prepacking based on backend selection.

classes.name: QConv1dPackWeightInt8
classes.description: Implementation for 1D quantized convolution weight prepacking, handling tensor adjustments and backend selection.
